Subject: POC kickoff — stakeholder intros + hands-on lab schedule

Hi Maria — great to meet you over the call last week. Were excited to get the POC started with Brightly. To make the hands-on lab efficient we usually run a 90–120 minute kickoff + working session that covers:

- quick intros and success criteria (10–15m)
- prompt & routing review with sample inputs (20–30m)
- hands-on inference run (live prompts) and KV/cache checks (30–45m)
- lightweight load-run to validate throughput targets (20–30m)
- next steps / acceptance criteria / owner assignments (10m)

Can you confirm the right people to include from Brightly (engineering, security, product) and two preferred windows next week? Were available Tue/Wed morning PT or Thu afternoon PT. Ill loop in Ben (customer success) and Aditya (solutions) — theyll run the lab and own the load tests.

Ill attach the draft runbook and a sample agenda; we can iterate.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
Redwood Inference

- Maria Gomez (Program Manager) — I will coordinate
- Alex Chen (VP Eng) — technical lead for the POC
- Priya N. (SRE) — eng-ops@brightlyhealth.com (covering infra & network)

Best windows for us: Tue 2026-08-18 09:30–11:30 PT or Wed 2026-08-19 13:00–15:00 PT. If you need to compress to 90 minutes we can prioritize the routing + load run.

For success criteria: the key things Alex wants validated are
- end-to-end latency p95 under 600ms for our typical 256-token prompts

Ill get Priya to confirm network contacts and share any firewall constraints.

Thanks,
Maria

Looping in a couple of operational notes from the lab side:

- Load target clarification: we suggest running two short ramps — 60s warmup to 120 rps and a 5-minute sustained window at target. If Brightly prefers, we can front-load a 30s 200rps spike to test autoscaling fallbacks.
- Observability: Ill attach a link to the shared trace dashboard during the session; please ensure one Brightly attendee has access ahead of time.
- Data handling: for the hands-on prompts we recommend sanitized examples. We do not persist inputs beyond session logs unless explicitly approved.

One ask for Alex/Priya: please confirm the test credentials and any IPs to allowlist by EOD Monday (2026-08-17).
